status: DRAFT_REQUIRES_REVIEW; does not supersede current schema/model

proposedUploadFields.name: owner_system
proposedUploadFields.comment: 上传目标所属业务系统代码，来自 Platform 受控代码目录；Client 入驻由 CCT 授权结果固定，浏览器不得提交。

proposedUploadFields.name: owner_type
proposedUploadFields.comment: 上传目标的受控资源类型；Client 入驻固定为 CLIENT_APPLICATION_SUBJECT，不允许上传后变更目标类型。

proposedUploadFields.name: owner_ref_id
proposedUploadFields.comment: 来源 Owner 定义的不可变目标坐标；Client 入驻为 CCT 的 applicationId:subjectPartyId，两段均为规范正整数 ID，不复制 Client 名称或其他可变事实。

proposedUploadFields.name: display_name
proposedUploadFields.comment: 去除路径和控制字符后的文件展示名，最大 255 Unicode 字符；仅授权页面展示，不作为对象存储 Key 或鉴权依据。

proposedUploadFields.name: storage_provider
proposedUploadFields.comment: 此次上传使用的对象存储适配器代码，来自受控配置；创建后固定，恢复不得改用当前默认适配器。

proposedUploadFields.name: storage_container_ref
proposedUploadFields.comment: 此次上传的目标存储容器引用；不含凭据，创建后固定，完成和恢复必须使用原容器。

proposedUploadFields.name: storage_object_ref
proposedUploadFields.comment: Platform 创建的高熵上传对象引用，不含原始文件名或个人资料；与适配器和容器组成上传目标，不能由浏览器替换。

proposedUploadFields.name: scan_policy_id
proposedUploadFields.comment: 本次上传在开始时冻结的 Platform File Scan Policy 修订 ID；完成后由 File 继承，不因等待期间默认策略变化而重选。

compensationTarget.reason: Reuse the already-approved Foundation runtime contract for a new Platform file-scan consumer; canonical Platform model synchronization still required
